newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U sets Biacore issue price 106.75 skr.
newsitem.headline: P&U sets Biacore issue price 106.75 skr.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn and Biacore International AB said the price for a share issue in Biacore was set at 106.75 crowns per share or $16 per American Depositary Share.
The companies said in a statement that altogether five million shares or the equivalent number of ADS had been offered to institutional investors in Sweden and abroad and to the Swedish public.
The offer was about eight times oversubscribed.
The shares in Biacore will be listed on the Stockholm bourse's O-list and on NASDAQ National Market System.
Pharmacia & Upjohn announced in November it would list its Biacore medical instruments unit through a global share issue.
Trade of the share on NASDAQ was due to begin later on Wednesday while trade in Stockholm would start on December 3.
"Based on the introductary price Biacore has a capital equity of 1.04 billion crowns, including the 1.5 million shares which Biacore would issue in connection with the offer," the companies said.
P&U said the offer would reduce its holding in Biacore to around 49 percent of the shares and votes in the company.
It said it would retain 374 million crowns from the issue.

Goldman Sachs International was the global co-ordinator and lead manager for the issue. Enskilda Securities was the co-lead manager in the international issue and responsible for the public offering in Sweden, they said.
Hambrecht and Quist was the co-manager in the U.S. issue and the co-lead manager in the international offer.
